title: Terms & Conditions

You're responsible for keeping your account credentials secure. If you believe your account has been compromised, contact us immediately.

We only access your email to provide the service. We never sell, rent, or share your content with third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: 4. Billing and refunds
paragraphs: Paid plans are billed monthly. You can cancel at any time and your plan will remain active until the end of the current billing period.
